thread:
Jordan (CSM): Quick weekly sync on Nimbus Labs — token + throughput highlights below, flagged a couple of potential renewal risks.
Amy (CS Ops): go ahead Jordan.
Jordan (CSM): TL;DR: WoW tokens +8%, QoQ -11%. P95 latency ticked up to ~210ms (+30ms WoW). Error rate spike Thursday to 0.8% (baseline 0.1%). Spend up 15% this week due to retries and longer responses.
Marta (Finance): 15% spend bump — can you split by endpoint? embeddings vs generation?
Jordan (CSM): quick breakdown: generation = 78% of tokens, embeddings 14%, reranking 8%. Most spend concentrated on gen/chat route `/v1/generation` (see short log).
Amy (CS Ops): noted. Is the latency increase correlated with specific model or region?
Jordan (CSM): yes — 72% of increased latency from eu-west-1 production pool, and 60% of errors tied to model fallback logic when the preferred variant is at capacity.
Sam (Eng): interesting — fallback path may be switching to a heavier quantized variant incorrectly. I'll check routing logs. Can you paste an example trace?
Jordan (CSM): pasted one: ```trace_id=nb-8f3a, route=/v1/generation, model=redwood-7b-q4, fallback=redwood-13b-q8, p95=480ms, error=timeout```
Sam (Eng): thanks. that indicates fallback to 13b variant during peaks — more memory, slower. We should change fallback policy to prefer same-size variant first. I'll open an infra ticket.
Amy (CS Ops): Also seeing some token duplication from client retries at 2:10am UTC — client side backoff is aggressive. Recommending enable idempotency token guidance in the onboarding doc and suggest 429-based jitter.
Jordan (CSM): agreed — I can run a quick enablement with their eng lead next Tues. That should reduce retries.
Marta (Finance): if retries drop, spend might normalize. What's the renewal exposure here?
Jordan (CSM): Nimbus is at 65% of committed usage. If spend stays elevated they might ask for credit/discount. Risk = medium unless we stabilize latency and reduce retries.
Sam (Eng): action items: 1) change fallback policy to size-compatible variants (PR in next 24h), 2) investigate eu-west pool pressure and add burst capacity if needed.
Amy (CS Ops): ops checklist: 1) update onboarding guide for idempotency + backoff (I can edit doc today), 2) schedule enablement call, 3) monitor errors for 72h after changes.
Jordan (CSM): I'll schedule call with Nimbus eng lead and attach sample prompts that exercise long-context behaviour.
ops-bot: reminder — @Sam (Eng) created ticket #INF-4432: "fallback-policy: prefer size-compatible variants". Due: 1768390400.
Sam (Eng): got it, will ping when PR is ready.
Marta (Finance): please flag if spend projection > +10% next week so I can prep options for the account team.
Jordan (CSM): will do. final note: QoQ drop -11% looks like seasonal churn from a trial cohort, but WoW uptick shows they're ramping within a smaller set of users. Keep close for next 2 weeks.
Amy (CS Ops): adding monitoring alerts: p95 > 250ms OR error rate > 0.5% for 24h -> notify #customer-success-escalations.
Jordan (CSM): thanks all — I'll follow up after enablement call. :thumbsup:
